prompt: Inside an airliner, shot through the rounded window: the wingtip with its red light, and three kilometres below a British city laid out as an orange grid. Two motorways run into it, packed with headlights, with fire racing along their lanes in bright stripes. A fuel depot on the edge churns orange, its smoke column leaning and lit from beneath. Several districts have dropped to black. 35mm. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
